segment.source: NetworkControl filters traffic in a background service; this window only displays and controls it. The window reconnects automatically as soon as the service is running.
segment.target: NetworkControl 由后台核心服务执行拦截，界面只负责展示和操作。服务启动后界面会自动重新连接。

segment.source: Development build: the button above starts the locally built service, or run "dotnet run --project src/NetworkControl.Service".
segment.target: 开发版本：点击上方按钮启动本地构建的服务，或运行 “dotnet run --project src/NetworkControl.Service”。

segment.source: The system service "NetworkControl" normally starts with the computer. Starting it manually requires administrator rights.
segment.target: 系统服务 “NetworkControl” 通常随系统自动启动，手动启动需要管理员权限。

segment.source: The service is not installed. Run "scripts/install-service.ps1" as administrator.
segment.target: 服务尚未安装。请以管理员身份运行 “scripts/install-service.ps1”。

segment.source: The service is not running: endpoint {0} does not exist.
segment.target: 服务未运行：端点 {0} 不存在。

segment.source: The service uses IPC protocol v{0}, but this window expects v{1}. Update both to the same version.
segment.target: 服务使用 IPC 协议 v{0}，界面需要 v{1}，请把两者更新到同一版本。

segment.source: The core service is not available
